## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The empty-criteria regression should be fixed because it weakens requirement proof validation.

## Changes
The pull request changes proof aggregation and adds a helper that checks whether batch entries are reviewed. This review read the added tests without running them.

(none)

## Important
- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — Keep empty requirements unproven — For `criteria=[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True`. Removing the previous `bool(criteria)` guard lets the new comparison evaluate `0 == 0`. — Callers can treat a requirement as proven without any supporting criteria. — Fix: Restore the nonempty guard and extend `test_requirement_with_evidence` with an empty list.
